context: GUARDRAILS: never bash as PID1 in a detached container (exits immediately without TTY - upstream --detach exits by design for this reason); never PasswordAuthentication; never bind-mount host SSH_AUTH_SOCK (unix sockets do not cross virtiofs - use ssh -A); never mount host ~/.ssh wholesale - only the generated per-project authorized_keys; --gc must never touch running containers; setup-ssh.sh idempotent (re-runs edit nothing already correct).
description: Persistent workspace mode for Desktop/SSH use. Ingress per GATE 0 Spike A verdict (publish 127.0.0.1:<port>:2222 or ProxyCommand container exec -i NAME nc 127.0.0.1 2222). sshd runs UNPRIVILEGED as user agent on 2222 with our config/sshd_config (PasswordAuthentication no, PermitUserEnvironment yes, AllowUsers agent) and per-project host keys generated ON THE HOST by setup-ssh.sh into ~/.agent-container/state/<project>/ssh/ and bind-mounted - image rebuilds never break known_hosts. Env propagation: sshd sessions do NOT inherit container --env, so the entrypoint writes declared AGENT_AUTH_ENVS to ~/.ssh/environment (mode 600) before sshd starts. OAuth state (Claude Max, Codex device auth) persists via AGENT_STATE_DIRS bind mounts under state/<project>/home-state/. Persistent PID1 is exec sshd -D. Deterministic port allocation with collision probe recorded in ~/.agent-container/ports.tsv. Add agent-run.sh --list/--stop/--gc lifecycle subcommands (gc reaps stopped persistent containers only).
